---
title: "comparison of coding mutations"
output: html_notebook
---
Notebook for performing comparisons of coding mutations between colibactin positive and
colibactin negative crypts 
dnds_annot_sum is derived from concatenation of per donor annotation of coding mutations
using dNdSsc (Methods)

# a : load in dnds all compi
```{r}
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
dnds_all_mutations <- read.csv("../Data/dnds_all_mutations.csv")
crypt_signature_attributions <- read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')

## combine crypt annotation of colibactin positive with dNdS outputs :
colibactin_crypts <- crypt_signature_attributions %>%
  select(patient,biopsy,crypt, biopsy_colibactin_pos,age,location,cohort)

# combine with dNdS annotation :
crypt_dnds_annot <- colibactin_crypts |>
  left_join(dnds_all_mutations, by = c("sample"='sampleID')) |>
  mutate(
    Effect = case_when(
      Effect == "nonsense" ~ "Nonsense",
      Effect == "missense" ~ "Missense",
      Effect %in% c("ess_splice", "5prime_UTR_ess_splice") ~ "Splice",
      Type %in% c("Ind", "Del") ~ "Indels",
      Effect %in% c(
        "nc_variant", "intronic",
        "5prime_UTR_variant", "3prime_UTR_variant"
      ) ~ "non_coding",
      TRUE ~ "Synonymous"
    )
  )
crypt_dnds_annot$patient=as.factor(crypt_dnds_annot$patient)
crypt_dnds_annot$biopsy=as.factor(crypt_dnds_annot$biopsy)
crypt_dnds_annot$location=as.factor(crypt_dnds_annot$location)
```

```{r}
## summarise for each crypt, the number of missense, nonsense, indels, synonymous  mutations:
# create summary
crypt_dnds_annot_sum <- crypt_dnds_annot %>%
  group_by(sample, Effect) %>%
  summarise(
    patient=dplyr::first(patient),
    biopsy=dplyr::first(biopsy),
    muts = n(),
    age=max(age),
    biopsy_colibactin_pos = any(biopsy_colibactin_pos),
    location=dplyr::first(location)) %>%
  filter(Effect %in% c("Missense", "Nonsense", "Indels", "Synonymous"))%>%
  mutate(Effect = factor( Effect, levels = c("Missense", "Nonsense", "Indels", "Synonymous"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Effect, values_from = muts)%>%
  mutate(across(c('Indels','Missense','Synonymous','Nonsense'), ~ replace_na(.x,0)))%>%
  gather(Effect,muts,-sample,-patient,-biopsy,-age,-biopsy_colibactin_pos,-location)%>%
  arrange(sample)
```

## b : test associations for mutations
```{r}

fit_effect_model <- function(effect) {
  summary(lmer(muts ~ biopsy_colibactin_pos + age + (1 | patient) + (1 | location), data = crypt_dnds_annot_sum[crypt_dnds_annot_sum$Effect == effect,]))}

ml_results <- list(
  Indels      = fit_effect_model("Indels"),
  Missense   = fit_effect_model("Missense"),
  Nonsense   = fit_effect_model("Nonsense"),
  Synonymous = fit_effect_model("Synonymous")
)

## extract p values from regression :
extract_colibactin_p <- function(model_summary) {
  coef_tab <- model_summary$coefficients
  p <- coef_tab["biopsy_colibactin_posTRUE", "Pr(>|t|)"]
}

coding_p_df <- tibble(
  Effect = names(ml_results),
  pvalue = purrr::map_dbl(ml_results, extract_colibactin_p))%>%
  mutate(Effect = factor(Effect, levels = c("Missense", "Nonsense", "Indels", "Synonymous")))

## adjust pvalues using Benhamini Hochberg :
coding_p_df$pvalue_adj=p.adjust(coding_p_df$pvalue,method='BH')
coding_p_df$label=case_when(coding_p_df$pvalue_adj<0.001 ~'P < 0.001',
                            TRUE~paste0('P = ',round(coding_p_df$pvalue_adj,digits=3)))

## extract y coords for plots:
y_coords<-crypt_dnds_annot_sum %>%
      group_by(Effect) %>%
      summarise(y = max(muts, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10)

coding_p_df <- coding_p_df %>%
  left_join(y_coords, by = "Effect")
print(coding_p_df)
```

## c : Figure 2.D: create a plot for comparison of coding mutations :
```{r}
svg('~/compare_coding_muts.svg',width=6, height=10)

# intiialise plot 
ggplot(crypt_dnds_annot_sum, aes(x = biopsy_colibactin_pos, y = muts)) +
  
  # create boxplot :
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = biopsy_colibactin_pos)) +
  
  # facet by effect
  facet_wrap(~Effect, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  
  # add text for pvalues and associated brackets
  geom_text(data = coding_p_df, aes(label = label, y = y, x = 1.5),fontface = "bold")+
  geom_segment(data = coding_p_df, aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = 0.96*y, yend = 0.96*y),color='grey20', inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = coding_p_df, aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = 0.96*y, yend = 0.945*y),  color='grey20',inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = coding_p_df, aes(x = 2, xend = 2, y = 0.96*y, yend = 0.945*y),  color='grey20',inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.6) +
  
  # format x and fill scales 
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = c(TRUE, FALSE), labels = c("Colibactin\nPositive", "Colibactin\nNegative")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('grey70','hotpink3')) +
  
  # add labels
  labs(y = "Coding Sequence Mutations per Crypt", x = "Colibactin Mutagenesis Status") +
  
  # format theme
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face='bold',colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14,colour = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.placement = "inside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
dev.off()
```

## d : cross validate with driver genes :
driver gene list taken from Cornish, A. J. et al. Nature, 2024
```{r}
## read in the list from cornish et al.
driver_genes_list<-read_excel('../Data/41586_2024_7747_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx',sheet=5,skip=7)
driver_genes<-driver_genes_list[1]

## intersect with the dnds annot sum:
drivers_count=nrow(crypt_dnds_annot[crypt_dnds_annot$Gene %in% driver_genes,])
print(paste0('Drivers present : ', drivers_count,' drivers'))
```
